does: Copies a roll's result (total, natural die, discarded die, critical, threshold and the dice counts) into another.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on a passive check's RequestedRollComponent Result.Total (+0xC8) and Result.NaturalRoll (+0xCC): written 18 at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0xE75F73 and 15 at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0xE75F7F, from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0xF1889D
A write watch on a roll request's result shows the total written at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0xE75F73 and the natural die at bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0xE75F7F inside this function
The name is ours: the Toolkit exports no function of this name and the macOS build's symbols hold none; it stands in the namespace of the functions that call it.
